title_vi: Nỗi đau của chàng Werther trẻ tuổi
translation_direction: de → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete German electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Goethe’s sentimental rhythm, dashes and exclamations are kept; the nature imagery (valley, linden trees, moon, spring) carries the mood.
decisions.rationale: The novel is its voice and its feeling.

decisions.decision: The translation covers exactly the first book of Gutenberg’s file; the novel’s ending and any second book are not claimed.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: “Anzügliches” (engaging, attractive) was rendered as unpleasant; corrected to attractive.
“Freundschaftsbezeigungen” (displays of friendship) was rendered as declarations of love; corrected.
The young men were described as flippant, not as going far; corrected.
Lotte’s address to Werther was inconsistent (“cô” then “anh”); made “anh” throughout.
The Melusine simile reversed who is bound; corrected.
“Chapeau” is her partner’s jocular name, not a hat; corrected.
The pastor’s unmarried daughter was given the wife’s role; corrected to the daughter.
The subject who risks his life is the man, not the arm; corrected.
The humbled party is “us”, not the giver; corrected.
“entweihten” has no agent; the Vietnamese no longer names the addressee as the profaner.
Werther sees Lotte’s eyes, not the reverse; corrected.
The direction of sending the books was reversed; corrected.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: Names kept as in the German.
The letter salutation to Wilhelm, one rendering.

glossary.draft_rendering: Werther–Lotte: em / anh (Lotte speaks to him as anh); Werther–Wilhelm: anh / bạn in letters

witness_decision: Selected Project Gutenberg #2407, an electronic transcription labelled ‘Die Leiden des jungen Werther — Band 1’, based on the Hamburger Ausgabe, Band 6. The Gutenberg page does not name the exact printing and the text was not collated with the 1774 first edition.

title_review.rationale: The title is rendered as ‘Nỗi đau của chàng Werther trẻ tuổi’ (The Sorrows of Young Werther); no earlier Vietnamese title was checked.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The title of the novel in the edition used.
The last unit: the closing words of the letters in Band 1.
